body:
GitHub issue #839.

PROBLEM
plugins/adlc-opencode/index.mjs returns early in tool.execute.before when e?.tool is falsy (`if (!tool) return;`), allowing a call with an empty or missing tool name before tracker.recordToolCall, checkHandoff, checkToolCall, and checkBuildGate run.

BUILD
1. In plugins/adlc-opencode/index.mjs execute.before, normalize `const tool = e?.tool ?? "";` and remove the early `if (!tool) return;` guard so missing/empty tool names fall through to tracker.recordToolCall, checkHandoff, checkToolCall, and checkBuildGate.
2. Add regression tests in plugins/adlc-opencode/test/rails-checker.test.mjs verifying that execute.before with an empty or missing tool name denies when rails are in force and no target path is extractable (or when targeting a frozen rail), and allows when rails are not in force.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
- AC1: execute.before with an empty or missing tool name is denied by checkToolCall while rails are in force. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-opencode/test/rails-checker.test.mjs`
- AC2: All adlc-opencode tests pass. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-opencode/test/*.test.mjs`
title: plugin(adlc-opencode): gate tool.execute.before calls with missing or empty tool names (#839)
